```suggestion
Fixed: `named-grid-areas-no-invalid` false positives for mix of tabs and spaces
```

To align with [our conventions](https://stylelint.io/maintainer-guide/issues#titles). We have a lot of entries in our [CHANGELOG](https://stylelint.io/CHANGELOG) and keeping things consistent helps users scan it and our release notes.  The positives/negatives bit helps us determine if it's a patch or minor change based on our [semver policy](https://stylelint.io/about/semantic-versioning/).
